title: Israel kills Iranian nuclear scientists first

tellings.quote: Who were the first people the Israelis killed in Iran when they went in?

plain: When Israel moved against Iran, the first people it killed were Iran's nuclear scientists, says the mathematician Eric Weinstein, putting it as a pointed question without naming a source. He uses it to argue that top physicists are treated as strategic targets, which would explain why advanced research, such as any work on UFOs, might be kept secret.
